# Split notes

*Auto-generated by `ml/scripts/make_splits.py`. Re-run with `dev.bat splits`.*

## Method

Cluster-aware 80/10/10 split. Whole mmseqs2 clusters at 40% identity are assigned to a single split via greedy bin-packing (largest cluster first, placed in the split with the largest remaining capacity). Class-pure clusters bin-pack independently per class so positives and negatives both hit the 80/10/10 target; mixed clusters (an AMP within 40% identity of a non-AMP) go to train so the held-out splits stay label-clean. Seed=42, deterministic.

Source: `ml\data\clusters\clusters.csv` (14162 clusters).

Cluster class composition: amp-pure=4387, neg-pure=9716, mixed=59
